history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-breeder-policy-x4-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-20: the owner redefined #482 as the breeder policy ladder in breeders-x4 (the switch arms were overridden by caution_breeder_policy 3): classes-18 gate, then small + medium (starts 1-360).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-20, before any result of these profiles was read (owner's redefinition of #482).
Gate:
- no config_error; one binary; every cell records world breeders-x4 with the same borg_world_data_sha256 in every arm;
- each arm's policy value in borg.txt and in params-core.json;
- the arms must play differently: at least p0 and p2 differ from p3 in some games. If an arm is identical to p3 in
  all 18 pilot games, stop and report it before the larger tiers;
- every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped (exit 2 means the world was not applied); frozen-turn bursts
  classified; death bundles reproduced with the same world.
Report per arm and per class: deaths and causes, final and maximum level, deepest level; breeder deaths (the killer
has MULTIPLY); paired rescued and newly killed against p3 (exact McNemar) and games identical to p3; breeders created
and killed per game; per game "# Breeders cannot be stopped", "No rest: ... breeders known" and the flees from a lost
level; mean max CL and DL against p3 with non-inferiority at #347's margins (CL -0.25, DL -0.25); a RULES 18 bin for
each arm. A breeder world is a stress test: a level that wins here still needs normal play's measurement (#460)
before its shipped value changes.
experiment.question: In the breeders-x4 world (borg-reborn-rs PR #740 head e41eb758), which level of the breeder policy (caution_breeder_policy 0-5, shipped 3) saves or costs games?
